headline: On last trading day, Sensex and Nifty rose led by IT, Pharma, and Reliance buying amid crude volatility.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 2 November.

why: Buying in Reliance Industries and foreign inflows supported gains in benchmark indices.
Strength in IT and Pharma sector stocks helped lift markets despite midcap pressure.
Global crude oil prices remaining elevated due to Middle East tensions created market volatility.
Corporate ex-date announcements for corporate actions attracted trader focus on major stocks.
whatHappening: Commercial LPG cylinder prices were hiked by approximately ₹10.
OPEC+ maintains oil production targets unchanged amid Gulf supply concerns.
Over 40 stocks, including Infosys and Asian Paints, are turning ex-date this week for dividends and splits.
Adani Ports surged 4% during recent trading as indices rebounded from lower levels.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today, Sunday, November 1, 2026, for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, November 2. In recent sessions, benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty traded with volatility but gained support from Reliance, IT, and Pharma stocks. Key upcoming market triggers include OPEC+ decisions, geopolitical updates, and over 40 stocks turning ex-date.
